title: An exceptional, passionate, and extremely knowledgeable guide
text:
Nuria is an exceptional guide. She is extremely professional, approachable, and, above all, very knowledgeable about the history, culture, and all the details that make every place she visits special. Her way of explaining is clear, enjoyable, and passionate, and she makes the experience much more interesting and enriching.
It is clear that she enjoys her work very much and that she puts all her knowledge and enthusiasm at the service of the visitors. Without a doubt, an excellent and highly recommended guide. Thank you very much, Nuria, for a fantastic experience!
author: madziabar

title: Wonderful experience

title: Barcelona hiking tour with spectacular views.

title: Awesome Barcelona Experience on a Road Less Traveled!
text:
Highly recommend!   A nature hike for a change of pace from the city, plenty of history and culture to experience, and pretty amazing views as a reward for your effort! We were fortunate to have a beautiful sunny day with spectacular views of Barcelona including Montserrat in the distance.
Our guide Nuria was spot on with all aspects of the excursion.  In addition to sharing her knowledge along a nicely paced hike, she was very thorough, sending helpful reminders, providing local recommendations and helping us navigate getting down the mountain.  We knew we were in good hands the entire time.
author: Denise_L

title: Best way to get to Tibidabo?  This.
text: Ok.  So I’m 48 and out of shape.  It was wet.  Not pouring like the other few days but wet.  Down tree, no problem.  This is the guide’s personal signature trip, and I 100% recommend it.  Rain or shine.  She even had gluten free cookies for us and we chatted on the way back down the mountain.  The views… oh the views.  Don’t take a bus.  Hike in the forest.  I loved it!  Thank you!!!!
author: Melissa_N

title: Fabulous hike with wonderful tour guide!
text: Nuria, our guide was incredibly prompt and proactive with her communication and directions to the place. We did a beautiful hike through the sprawling national park in Barcelona (Baixador de Vallvidrera) amid breathtaking views and sparkling conversations with Nuria. It was approximately  a hour 15 minutes of walking on both flat surfaces and gentle inclines until we eventually reached the beautiful church at Tibidabo. Nuria gave us a wonderful tour of the space and also accompanied us back on a quaint minibus to the Tibidabo Funicular and then to the train station where we were able to trace
